questions.stem: A cleanup task must run after its upstream tasks finish, whether they succeeded or failed. Which Run if condition fits?
questions.explanation: All done runs the task once every dependency has finished, whatever the outcome.

questions.stem: A notification task should run only when one or more of its upstream tasks failed. Which Run if condition fits?
questions.explanation: At least one failed runs the task when one or more dependencies failed.

questions.stem: A job must take one of two paths depending on whether a row count passed from an earlier task is above zero. Which task type expresses that branch?
questions.explanation: The If/else condition task compares two values and runs the true or the false branch.

questions.stem: A team needs to run the same notebook once for each of 40 region codes, with up to 5 running at a time. Which task type fits?

options.text: Forty copies of a notebook task
For each, with the region list as inputs and concurrency set to 5

questions.explanation: A For each task loops a nested task over a list of inputs, with a setting for how many run at once.

questions.stem: A task calls an API that sometimes fails for a few seconds. Which task settings help it recover on its own? Choose two.

options.text: Setting the Run if condition to All failed
A retry policy with a number of retries

questions.explanation: A task's retry policy sets how many times to retry and how long to wait between attempts.
